title: Exact derived ordinary Zariski module stalk functor
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $y\in Y$, and fix the unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. The ordinary Zariski module stalk functor $S_y:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_{Y,y})$ [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] is additive and exact: it preserves homology and finite limits and colimits. Define the exact derived Zariski stalk functor $\mathrm{St}_y:D(\mathcal O_Y)\to D(\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_{Y,y}))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] to be $S_y.\mathrm{mapDerivedCategory}$, using the standard localization of the stalk-module category. Thus it is the functor induced by applying ordinary module stalks degreewise to unbounded complexes and then localizing at quasi-isomorphisms; its comparison with degreewise stalks is the exact-functor localization comparison. No boundedness or quasi-coherence condition is imposed.
